description: Adsorption Energy of NH3 on Cu(111) Surface (FCC Fm-3m, non-magnetic, PBE)
user_prompt: Calculate the adsorption energy of NH3 on the Cu(111) surface (Fm-3m). Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+NH3) - E(slab) - E(NH3).

method.modeling: Cu(111) slab with at least 4 layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom, and a 3x3x1 or larger surface supercell; adsorb molecular NH3 N-down at an atop Cu site. Reference Eads to the clean Cu(111) slab plus isolated gas-phase NH3.
method.rationale: Value follows the reported molecular NH3 adsorption energy on clean Cu(111) in Jiang et al., using this benchmark's negative Eads convention. The intended final state is weak N-down molecular adsorption near an atop Cu site. The +/-0.20 eV absolute tolerance covers PW91/PBE differences, coverage, site sensitivity, and dipole-correction details.
